mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, which may increase cholecalciferol metabolism and conversion to active metabolites, potentially elevating serum calcium levels; additionally, macrolide antibiotics can increase intestinal calcium absorption.
action: Monitor serum calcium and phosphate levels during concurrent use; assess for signs of hypercalcemia (nausea, polyuria, weakness); consider dose adjustment of cholecalciferol if hypercalcemia develops.
